records.words: Back to Valley. Last time I left bored on 18 July with Zehra delaying. This is the spoken-answer edition, I gather. I want to see the barley cut before the rain.
This is the start of 18 July again, not where I left. Not my saved place, but it is the prepared one. I know the call worked before, so I call first.
Zehra again, same delay. Last time sitting at her house ate my afternoon. This edition promises a spoken answer during visits, so I will try visiting once more and see whether I can say something.
Visiting. I will not send grain blind this time until I know the sack size.
Now it says 20 game minutes until arrival, 130 until home. That is the number I wanted last time. I can wait knowing what for.

Returning, I called the hamlet and went straight to Zehra. This time the walk shows game minutes until arrival and home, which answers what confused me last time. I have arrived and there is a new choice: Say: I came to listen. Seven people have now postponed, not one. That worries me with rain on the twentieth.
I came to listen is what I would say. I will not insist.
Yusuf says Come in. Zehra has not answered my words. I said I came to listen, but there is nothing to listen to yet. Checking how much barley is cut while I sit.
About 1 cut, 360 standing, rain in two days. I cannot tell whether five reapers is enough pace. Same question I had last time.

Twenty-five seconds and the clock did not move from 09:00. Eight copies of the same delay, each with Hold to insist. This is exactly where I got bored last time. I will not insist on eight people; I will try Skip instead, which says it keeps the slowdown.
I am walking back already. Zehra never answered what I said; I only got Yusuf saying Come in. Did my listening do anything? Checking her house record.

The spoken answer was one fixed sentence, and nobody answered it; the record just says Yusuf: Come in. Now nine delays are piling up again and I can only insist. Knowing the walking minutes helped, but the afternoon is shaping up like last time.
Home again at 10:30. Half a game hour per half minute of mine; rain is two days off, which would take far longer than my evening. I will look at Tepe, which has three delays, before deciding.

Same sentence from Tepe, and a Visit would be another two game hours of sitting with nobody answering me. I returned hoping the spoken answer would make visits a conversation; it was one line I said into the room. I would leave now, at 10:30 on the same 18 July where I left last time.
Opening the menu to check Feedback before I go.

I am stopping at 10:30 on 18 July. Coming back, the walking minutes answered my old question, and the menu still holds time. But the spoken answer was a single line nobody replied to, and the same delays are stacking up with only Hold to insist offered. I selected I'm stopping; the game filled the note itself, and I typed and submitted nothing. I would return another evening only if I could tell whether five or fourteen reapers will beat the rain, and if visiting led to an actual reply. I would not leave it running.
